project_name: CyrusOne Freestone Energy Center data center
status_detail: Constellation/Calpine announced a 380 MW agreement with CyrusOne for a new data center adjacent to the Freestone Energy Center in Freestone County, plus an exclusive agreement for Phase 2 adding another 380 MW. Local news reported a June 17, 2026 county reinvestment-zone hearing for phase-two property across FM 488 and described the AI data center as being built in that area.
notes: Capacity is 380 MW initial plus 380 MW phase 2 per Constellation/Calpine announcement. DCD and local newspaper add construction/filing and reinvestment-zone context.

status_detail: Developer site says Energy Ranch is a large-scale energy and digital infrastructure platform in Frio County designed to deliver an initial 250 MW of behind-the-meter power beginning in early 2028, scalable to 1-5 GW, for hyperscale cloud and AI infrastructure. San Antonio Business Journal reported the Frio County data center plan had reversed course toward microgrids and natural gas pipeline infrastructure for large-scale computing operations.
notes: Classified as planned digital infrastructure rather than a conventional owned data center building because the latest reporting says the developers pivoted to power/microgrid infrastructure supplying compute operations.

status_detail: datacenter.fyi/interconnection.fyi list an operational Seaboard Marine data center in Gaines County, Texas, on County Road 309, with 0.399 MW power capacity and 0.239 MW IT load connected to Lyntegar Electric Coop.

project_name: Dataprana La Marque 30MW immersion-cooled data center
status_detail: Dataprana says its 30 MW immersion-cooled digital asset mining data center in La Marque, Texas launched operations in Q2 2025; GlobeNewswire release says the flagship 30MW facility officially launched July 22, 2025.
notes: Developer page and company release provide capacity and operational timing; third-party map confirms Galveston County location/address context.

project_name: Dataprana / DC Futureminds Galveston County AI proof-of-concept data center
aliases: Dataprana first AI data center in Texas
status_detail: Dataprana announced a joint R&D memorandum with DC Futureminds to co-develop and construct its first AI data center in Galveston County, Texas; DCD described it as a 1.5 MW AI proof-of-concept facility in the same county.
notes: Separate from the 30 MW La Marque mining facility; status remains announced/planned because no launch evidence was found.
